duration: [Instantenous | End of Phase | 1 Round | Scene | Persistent]

Acid Arrow.name: Acid Arrow
Acid Arrow.description: You conjure an arrow of acid and hurl it at the target, dealing 1 Damage and 1 Durability Damage. Additional Successes increase both Damage and Durability Damage

Shock.name: Shock
Shock.description: A target within range is struck by electricity, taking 1 Damage and making their next 0 AP Action cost 1 AP.

Scald.name: Scald
Scald.description: Choose a Space within range. All creatures in the affected area take 1 Damage and are Exposed(1)

Flash Freeze.name: Flash Freeze
Flash Freeze.description: Choose a Space within range. All creatures in the affected area take 1 Damage and are Slowed(2). Water in the area Freezes.

Gust.name: Gust
Gust.description: Summon a sudden gust of wind that immediately despawns. Creatures in the area are Vertical Pushed 2 Spaces. Additional Successes increase the Push distance by 1 Space.

Motivate Earth.name: Motivate Earth
Motivate Earth.description:
You summon a Size 1 rock in a Space on the ground below or within 1 Space of yourself. You may then launch it in a line along the ground to a Space within range, stopping when it collides, dealing 1 Damage and Pushing the target 1 Space. Creatures on top of the boulder move with it.
If a suitable Boulder is within Range of this spell, you can hurl it with this spell for 1 less Focus.
